crossRefs.note: Haven’t you made a hedge around him, and around his house, and around all that he has, on every side? You have blessed…
Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?
The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will…
He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh, but his friendship is with the upright.
For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

translations.web: as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was in my tent,
translations.bsb: when I was in my prime, when the friendship of God rested on my tent,
translations.kjv: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle;
translations.asv: As I was in the ripeness of my days, When the friendship of God was upon my tent;
